snippet.title: Gobutiko - Official Gameplay Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Gobutiko, an inventory merchant management game developed by NCrafters. Players will make use of their trusty dice to haggle prices and embody a renowned goblin merchant. Gobutiko is coming soon to PC (Steam).
